ts/test/rewind-render-cli.test.ts::renderRewind: JSON > %i attempts with statuses %j reports %i dropped (#1584)
assumptions: Disclose rather than downgrade: the outcome is still classified from the readable attempts (one failure plus unreadable attempts stays `reproduced`), but the text line appends `N of M requested attempts not counted` and JSON gains `dropped` whenever any requested attempt was not counted. This is the lane's recommended default for the disclose-vs-downgrade fork.

`dropped` counts both unreadable attempts and skipped/pending ones (everything requested that the outcome was not built from); `statuses` already lists the skipped/pending ones, so unreadable = attempts - statuses.length is derivable.
For `not-run` (e.g. install failed, zero attempts executed) JSON reports `dropped` = attempts; the text line for not-run is unchanged.
